name: Fremont County, ID
findings: Fremont County has 18 nonprofit organizations. 5 of them (28%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 5 organizations.
Compared with 10 similar places, Fremont County has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
40% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in Fremont County list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 46% of the typical level).
